npcs.name: Aventus Aretino
npcs.greet: Go away. Unless... unless you're the one. Are you the one the Night Mother sent?

npcs.name: Astrid
npcs.greet: Every family has its rules. Ours are simple: obey, don't betray, and never kill a Brother or Sister.

npcs.name: Nazir
npcs.greet: Contracts, coin and corpses. In that order, if we're lucky.

npcs.name: Cicero
npcs.greet: Hello, hello! Cicero tends the Mother. Cicero does not like to be interrupted. Unless it's for a joke!

npcs.name: Amaund Motierre
npcs.greet: You are late. Never mind. What I am about to ask has not been asked in four hundred years.

relics.name: Amaund Motierre's Sealed Letter
relics.desc: A writ of execution. The name on it is the Emperor's.

abduction: You fall asleep. You wake on the floor of a shack you've never seen, wrists free, door barred. Three hooded figures kneel, bound, along the wall.
Sleep well? You killed Grelod. A contract that was ours to take. Now you owe us a life. One of these three. Your choice.
night_mother: My child. You have been chosen. Go to the Emperor's man in Volunruud, and listen.
She spoke! She spoke to you! Oh, the Listener, the Listener has come!
sanctuary_burns: Smoke rises from the Sanctuary's door. The Penitus Oculatus found it. The Black Door hangs broken.
They came at dawn. Astrid sold us to them, and then they killed her too. We go to the old Sanctuary in Dawnstar. We finish this.
emperor: So. The Dark Brotherhood. I knew someone would come. Do me one favor: find the man who paid for this, and do to him what you are about to do to me.
The Emperor of Tamriel does not reach for a weapon.

quests.title: Innocence Lost
quests.pitch: I've been doing the Black Sacrament. Grelod the Kind runs the Honorhall orphanage in Riften, and there's nothing kind about her. Please. Kill her. I'll give you everything I have.
quests.desc: A boy in Windhelm, Aventus Aretino, has been performing the Black Sacrament to summon an assassin. He wants Grelod the Kind, who runs the orphanage in Riften, dead.

objectives.text: Tell Aventus Aretino that Grelod is dead
objectives.reply: Really? She's really dead? Then the Night Mother heard me. Here, it's all I have. Thank you. Thank you!

quests.title: With Friends Like These...
quests.desc: I took a contract that belonged to the Dark Brotherhood, and the Brotherhood noticed. I woke up in an abandoned shack with three bound prisoners and a woman named Astrid.

objectives.text: Kill one of the three hooded captives

objectives.reply: Not a moment's hesitation. Welcome to the family. Our Sanctuary is in the pine forest near Falkreath. The password is 'Silence, my brother.'

quests.title: Whispers in the Dark
quests.desc: Cicero, the Keeper of the Night Mother's coffin, has been listening to her for years and hearing nothing. Then she spoke, and she spoke to me.

objectives.text: Speak to Cicero beside the Night Mother
objectives.topic: Why are you staring at me?
objectives.reply: Because she spoke to you! Listen, listen! She wants you to go!
Then here is the contract, and it is not a small one. Titus Mede the Second. The Emperor. He arrives in Skyrim soon. Take the letter to your Sanctuary, and seal the deal.

objectives.topic: The Emperor. We're to kill the Emperor.
objectives.reply: The Emperor. The Brotherhood hasn't had a contract like this since the Mythic Dawn. Before we strike, we take care of the people close to him.

quests.title: Bound Until Death
quests.desc: The Emperor's cousin, Vittoria Vici, is to be married in Solitude. A wedding is a fine place for a funeral.

objectives.text: Travel to Solitude for the wedding
Kill Vittoria Vici during her wedding

objectives.reply: And the Empire will be crying into its wine for a week. Good. Next, the Emperor himself.

quests.title: Death Incarnate
quests.desc: The Penitus Oculatus, the Emperor's guards, found the Sanctuary. Astrid betrayed us to save herself, and they killed her anyway.

objectives.text: Kill the Penitus Oculatus agents in the Sanctuary

objectives.reply: Now? Now we finish the contract. The Emperor's ship is docked at Solitude. We go in, we kill him, we disappear. Sithis is watching.

quests.title: Hail Sithis!
quests.desc: The Emperor's ship, the Katariah, lies at anchor off Solitude. It is time to fulfill the contract of the age.

objectives.text: Board the Katariah at the Solitude Docks

spawn.name: Titus Mede II, Emperor of Tamriel

objectives.reply: Hail Sithis! The Dark Brotherhood lives, and you, Listener, are its heart. Here's your share. It's a big share.
